name: krar-begena-studio
description: Microtonal Acoustic Synthesizer & Tab Tutor for Ethiopian Lyres

scripts.build:web: cd krar_flutter && flutter build web && cp -r ../krar_engine/pkg build/web/pkg
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:engine:ios && cd krar_flutter && flutter build ios
scripts.build:ios:sim: npm run build:engine:ios && cd krar_flutter && flutter build ios --simulator --debug
scripts.dev: cd krar_flutter && rm -rf web/pkg && cp -r ../krar_engine/pkg web/pkg && flutter run -d chrome --web-port=8080
